sam: Getting 400 from /v1/rerank in our staging tests. Error message: "Invalid request body: items must be a non-empty array". Happened on batched request (N=4). Posting curl we used.

sam: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{\n    \"queries\": [\"how to reset password\"],\n    \"topk\": -1,\n    \"candidates\": [{\"text\":\"reset steps\", \"score\": \"0.9\"}]\n  }'
```

support-bot: ERROR 400 (schema_validation) — req_id=rs-0a1b2c3d — message: "items is required"

ingrid: Thanks — a couple quick checks: can you paste the raw body (not curl-escaped) and the req_id from the response? Also did you copy/paste from any editors that might add a BOM?

sam: req_id: rs-0a1b2c3d. Raw body below (copied from client log). Starting bytes show weird char at start: \ufeff{\"queries\":...} — looks like BOM. Full string: 

﻿{\"queries\":[\"how to reset password\"],\"topk\":-1,\"candidates\":[{\"text\":\"reset steps\",\"score\":\"0.9\"}]}

kevin: Ok this is a few issues in one request:
- leading UTF-8 BOM can cause some JSON parsers to treat the first token incorrectly, depending on client lib.
- payload uses "queries" instead of required "items" key (our schema expects items).
- topk is negative (must be integer >= 1).
- candidate.score is a string, we expect numeric.
Any one of these can cause a 400; combined they make the validator fail early.

ingrid: For immediate unblock, try sending a minimal valid payload: 

sam: ```json
{
  "items": [
    {"id": "q1", "text": "how to reset password"}
  ],
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "c1", "text": "reset steps", "score": 0.9}
  ],
  "topk": 1
}
```

support-bot: Quick repro tip from infra: requests with BOM are accepted by some proxies but rejected at our JSON schema layer. We log parse errors as "unexpected_character" before schema validation. If you can reproduce, include curl -v output.

sam: Re-ran with cleaned payload and topk=1, replaced "queries"->"items" and score numeric — works, returns 200 and ranked ids. Thanks.

ingrid: Great — we'll add a short blurb to the support KB: common causes for rerank 400s = BOM, wrong topk type/value, wrong keys (queries vs items), candidates with missing id/text or string-typed numeric fields. If you can share the client library that produced the BOM, we can add a note for others.

sam: Using internal JS client that serializes request body — I will check the serializer and strip Byte Order Mark on our end. Thanks all :thumbsup:
